# Request-open metadata

The owned body isolates the metadata callback; stateful-parent.js and canonical-parent.js keep complete scopes used for ordered witnesses and candidate ownership.
The static JavaScript inputs include [owned-body.js](owned-body.js) and
[stateful-parent.js](stateful-parent.js).

[naming_xhr_open_metadata.rs](../../../naming_xhr_open_metadata.rs) is the integration consumer.
A sealed-capture wrapper around the owned body establishes the focused positive. Whole-parent witnesses preserve ordering. Mutations reject changed metadata, receiver, method/message protocols, and same-binding capture behavior.

These are source-analysis fixtures, not runnable browser programs.
Keep complete lexical parents, declaration/reference identity, native spellings,
and statement order. Tests locate exact source bodies and, in some cases,
assert byte spans; even whitespace changes can invalidate the control.
Preserve each independent layout rather than deriving one from the other.
Read the linked assertions before editing, then continue with the
[naming fixtures overview](../README.md) and [naming implementation](../../../../src/naming/README.md).
